title: Memory Atom — Architecture (v1)
description: Schema for specs/memory/architecture.yaml. Governs the architecture memory atom. additionalProperties:false enforces D-5 atomicity — a changelog/history/versions field is structurally impossible.

overview.description: Prose description of the overall architecture. Maps to template variable: architecture_overview.

layers.description: Ordered list of architectural layers. Renderer iterates and builds layers_html (div.layer blocks).

description.description: Prose description of this layer's responsibilities and rules.

dependency_rules_diagram.description: Mermaid diagram source (block scalar). Maps to template variable: dependency_rules_mermaid.

data_flow_diagram.description: Mermaid diagram source for the primary data flow. Maps to template variable: data_flow_mermaid. Multiple diagrams may be embedded as a single multi-section string.

contracts.description: Module-to-module contracts. Each entry maps to one table row. Template variable: contracts_rows (4 columns: De / Para / Tipo / Notas).

runtime_state.description: List of canonical runtime state locations and their purpose. Each entry maps to one <li> bullet. Template variable: runtime_state_bullets.

screenshots.description: Optional visual evidence items. Each entry produces an tag. Template variable: screenshots_html.

src.description: Path or URL to the screenshot.

caption.description: Optional caption shown below the image.
